# pve-rclone-backup verify

Verification history.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`history`](#verify-history) | Show verification runs |

## verify history

Show verification runs.

```
pve-rclone-backup verify history [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--limit int` | maximum number of runs per storage (default `50`) |
| `--storage string` | only this storage |
| `--volid string` | only this backup |

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
